newsitem.title: USA: Hollywood Casino to spin off Pratt Hotel.
newsitem.headline: Hollywood Casino to spin off Pratt Hotel.

text.p: Hollywood Casino Corp said on Wednesday it would spin off its 80.1 percent ownership of Pratt Hotel Corp, or 4.2 million shares, to its stockholders of record on December 24.
The company said it would distribute the shares on December 31 and that Hollywood Casino would start trading without the value of Pratt Hotel on December 20.
Trading of Pratt shares was also expected to start on December 20 on the American Stock Exchange on a "when distributed" basis, the company said.
Pratt Hotel would also change its name to Greater Bay Casino Corp effective December 31, the company said.
These shares were expected to start trading on the American Stock Exchange under the symbol GBY.A on January 2, Hollywood Casino said.
Greater Bay shares would be distributed on the basis of about 0.17 of Greater Bay share for each outstanding Hollywood Casino share, it said.
The spinoff would enable each business to pursue its own independent interests and provide financial flexibilty, Hollywood Casino said.
But Pratt's major asset, the Sands Hotel and Casino in Atlantic City, N.J., would continue its conversion to a Hollywood Casino themed property, the company said.
Cash would paid in lieu of fractional shares during the spinoff, the company said.
